prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / sketch-to-render.
Asset type: premium ecommerce product photography, a single transparent PNG product cutout in a landscape 4:3 canvas, approximately 2000 x 1500.
Primary request: Assemble the supplied Sea Realm STARTER KIT flat artwork into one photorealistic closed rectangular board-game box, preserving the actual graphics, original white script SeaRealm logo with wave underline and trademark, colors, and all typography exactly.
Input images: Image 1 is the FRONT artwork and must fill the front face edge-to-edge as a printed texture, preserving the entire layout. Image 2 is the RIGHT SIDE panel print, to fold into its correct side orientation. Image 3 is the TOP panel print; ignore trim and glue tabs and use only the central rectangular panel on the box top.
Geometry: broad landscape box standing upright on its long bottom edge, physical proportions approximately 11 inches wide x 7.25 inches tall x 2 inches deep. Closed, perfectly straight rectangular box, realistic narrow lid/base seam, matte/satin laminated printed cardboard, sharp but natural folded edges. Show dominant front, a narrower RIGHT side, and a small amount of top; gentle three-quarter turn, camera around 10–15 degrees above center, long-lens product photography with minimal perspective distortion.
Composition: single box centered, fully visible with all corners uncropped, fills about 75–80 percent of canvas width, ample transparent margin around it. Consistent soft upper-left studio lighting and subtle natural contact shadow with transparent falloff. Neutral faithful color rendering; no dramatic glare.
Front print invariants: exact reference ocean blue underwater backdrop, dolphin upper left, blurred distant fish upper right, purple/teal parrotfish lower left, vivid green parrotfish lower right, pink coral lower left, golden branching coral and small pufferfish lower right. These remain printed illustration on the cardboard, not physical creatures.
Exact front text: the original SeaRealm logo; "Have You Walked in the Recesses of the Deep?"; "STARTER KIT"; "EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO PLAY!". Top and side use the original SeaRealm logo and "STARTER KIT" in the supplied artwork.
Do not redesign, recolor, replace, omit, rephrase or add to the print. Remove all manufacturing trim outlines, dielines, dimensions, drawing annotations, transparent margins, and glue tabs from the assembled result. No props, no loose game contents, no extra packages, no background scene, no added labels or watermark. Preserve real alpha transparency; do not draw a checkerboard.
